exposure: Mode of delivery (vaginal delivery vs. cesarean section)
cohort: 2,138 extremely preterm infants (gestational age <26 weeks) born between 2003 and 2012
finding: Cesarean section does not improve mortality and neurodevelopmental outcomes at 3 years of age in extremely preterm infants.
mod_finding: Cesarean section did not improve the composite outcome of death or NDI at 3 years of age in extremely preterm infants.
